versions.changelog:
Initial release of the registry-dashboard-53592 liveness heartbeat tool.

- Sends a JSON liveness heartbeat to a dashboard endpoint defined in scripts/app.json.
- Utilizes a Unix domain socket for communication (`~/.local/state/profile-sync/daemon.sock`).
- Requires initialization with `--init` to set up configuration.
- Prints the result of the heartbeat and exits.
- Operates with minimal permissions: filesystem (read/write) and network egress.
